stem.text: Compound X has stereoisomers and forms a precipitate when warmed with Fehling's reagent.
What could be the structure of compound X?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: a branched chain with a methyl branch at the top, a C=C double bond, and a C=O group at the right end with the O drawn below.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: a chain with a C=C double bond at the left, a C=O group in the middle with the O drawn below, and a methyl group at the far right.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: a C=O group with the O drawn above, a methyl branch drawn downward from the chain, and chain ends at the left and right.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: a branched chain with a methyl branch at the top and a C=O group at the right end with the O drawn below.
